change: Opt-in version-2 destination report digest and expected snapshot check inside the existing read transaction; default version-1 output unchanged. CLI checks before private file output.
limitations: Synthetic temporary ledgers only. No actual mission checkpoint edited or accepted registry configured. Snapshot match is point-in-time metadata, not authenticated review, lease, future-write gate or delivery evidence. No strict packet, stored profile or database schema changes.
next_task: Exact-revision independent review; retain one saved registry candidate until owner acceptance and intended audience/access policy verification permit operational adapter work.
observed_gap: Destination metadata reports lacked the optional exact snapshot check already available for queue reports. This is a bounded feature addition, not a reproduced code failure.
regressions: Read-only restart preserves paused/unknown holds; context review changes invalidate snapshots; unrelated destination changes do not.
Project/platform/destination and matching membership bind the snapshot; invalid options reject without record writes; returned data stays independent.
Fresh-process CLI rejects changed context before creating output directories, writes matching report mode 0600, refuses duplicate output without changing file/database bytes.
